create.name: Brian Lesage
create.bio:
Brian Lesage is an American teacher of insight meditation whose teaching draws on Burmese Theravada practice, the Thai Forest tradition and the early Buddhist discourses. He began meditating in 1988 and has practised in Zen, Theravada and Tibetan schools. He took ordination as a Rinzai Zen monk in 1996 and lived for six years in a strict Zen monastic setting before turning to insight practice, with long retreats in Burma, Nepal and India. He received permission to teach from Eric Kolvig and through the teacher training run jointly by Spirit Rock and IMS.

He has taught since 2000, in prisons, schools, universities and recovery settings as well as sitting groups, and now gives most of his time to leading retreats and supporting local sanghas, mainly in the American South West. His retreats run from weekends to a week or more, at places such as the Mountain Hermitage near Taos, Vallecitos in New Mexico, Pecos Monastery, Spirit Rock and IMS, where he also helps teach part of the three-month autumn retreat. He offers one-to-one practice mentoring and writes essays on the Dharma. He is also a certified Somatic Experiencing practitioner and brings attention to the body into his support of meditators.
